ui.title: Magic Workshop
ui.intro: Choose a style and see what kind of magical portrait your pet could get.

styles.name: Pastel Storybook
styles.desc: A soft, Japanese-inspired storybook illustration: sparkling eyes, delicate pastel colors and painted watercolor textures.

styles.name: Digital 3D Clay
styles.desc: Your pet as a hand-sculpted clay figure in soft light, in a little pastel lavender world. The clay slightly simplifies the shapes.

styles.name: Comic Book Hero
styles.desc: Your pet becomes the hero of a vintage American comic book, with its own violet-and-gold cape and paw medallion, ink lines and halftone dots.

styles.name: Pixel Art
styles.desc: Your pet as a retro video game character, made of sharp square pixels, in a starry night landscape.

styles.name: Mexican Flower Fiesta
styles.desc: A joyful Mexican folk-art portrait: a flower crown, marigolds and roses, papel picado banners and candlelight.

styles.name: Ukiyo-e
styles.desc: The world of traditional Japanese woodblock prints: fine outlines, classic colors, stylized waves and clouds, Mount Fuji in the distance.

styles.name: Christmas
styles.desc: A warm Christmas scene by the fireplace with lights and gifts. Your pet gets a Santa hat and a knitted scarf.

styles.name: Golden Icon Portrait
styles.desc: In the style of old icon painting: a gold-leaf background, a finely cracked antique surface and an ornate gilded frame.

styles.name: Fairy-Tale Witch
styles.desc: A fairy-tale magic world with a pointed witch hat: the cat sits on a crescent moon, the dog guards a magical library.

styles.name: Mandala Ink Drawing
styles.desc: A black-and-white ink drawing in which your pet is filled with mandala patterns. You can print it and color it in. Fur color is not shown in this style.

styles.name: Viking Warrior
styles.desc: Your pet as a brave Viking warrior: a fur cloak, an iron helmet, a fjord, a longship and the northern lights.

styles.name: Steampunk
styles.desc: The world of retro-futurism: brass aviator goggles, a geared harness, a steamy workshop and an airship at sunset.

styles.name: Tarot Card
styles.desc: Your pet as the main figure of an ornate, gold-framed tarot card, in a starry, moonlit landscape.
